lines: •Reiterated $500 million run-rate cost savings across capital, lease operating expense and G&A by year-end 2026;
•Increased full-year 2026 free cash flow outlook to approximately $2.9 billion, reflecting stronger operating performance and higher commodity prices;

Upstream capital investment was $466 million, approximately $30 million below guidance, primarily reflecting timing impacts of GranMorgu capital spending that shifted into the fourth quarter; lease operating expense was $418 million.
Consistent with its established capital returns framework, APA expects to return at least 60% of 2026 free cash flow to shareholders while continuing to strengthen its balance sheet.
Full-year abandonment and decommissioning expenditures are now expected to total $285 million, a $15 million reduction from prior guidance.
At current strip prices, APA expects to generate approximately $2.9 billion of free cash flow in 2026, an increase of $600 million from its August update.
